fieldGuidance.name: App name shown on the store. MUST begin with the brand "Wren" followed by a short, localized descriptor (e.g. "Wren – Daily Expense Tracker"). Keep "Wren" verbatim; transcreate only the descriptor. If the natural descriptor will not fit, shorten it — never drop the brand and never exceed the limit.
fieldGuidance.subtitle: Short tagline shown under the name. Punchy and benefit-driven, not a literal translation of the English. Title-case/sentence-case per local convention.
fieldGuidance.promotional_text: Short promotional banner (editable without a new app version). Lead with the most compelling, current hook.
fieldGuidance.keywords: Comma-separated search terms, not a translation; follow the Keywords section. Fill as much of the byte budget as natural terms allow, and no more.
fieldGuidance.description: Full listing description. Transcreate persuasively into natural, native marketing prose — adapt idioms and flow, do not calque the English. Preserve the overall structure and line breaks (paragraphs, the bulleted feature list, the closing line).
fieldGuidance.release_notes: The "What's New" text shown on the update sheet. Match the tone of the English; keep it warm and concise.
